SET:PTTGC.note_from_cgsi: TWO consecutive loss years — TRACTION SCREEN REQUIRED; loss narrowing

net_income.note: Net income, not operating cash flow — reported for context, and NOT counted toward the four tests.

answers.revenue_growth_evidence: Revenue FELL 20%: FY2024 THB604,045m -> FY2025 THB484,907m, on lower product prices and planned maintenance shutdowns at MEG, the Refinery and Aromatics Unit 2.
answers.cash_flow_evidence: Net cash from operating activities (consolidated): FY2025 THB 40,830m vs FY2024 THB 32,322m - positive both years, up ~26%. Read from the audited FY2025 financial statements (year ended 31 Dec 2025), statement of cash flows, p.13. Note the contrast with the net loss of THB 15,572m: non-cash addbacks (depreciation THB 26,383m, impairment THB 1,984m) plus a THB 15,728m swing in trade payables carry operating cash positive. EBITDA was NOT substituted.
answers.order_book_evidence: No contracted order book or backlog disclosed. Full-text search of Form 56-1 One Report 2025 (207pp, text layer present on every page) for 'backlog', 'order book', 'contracted revenue' and 'offtake' returns no disclosure. Nearest items, neither qualifying: a qualitative credit-risk note that the majority of customers are on long-term contracted commitments (no figure attached), and capital commitments contracted but not provided for of THB 3,868m (capex GC owes, not a revenue backlog).
answers.green_pipeline_evidence: No signed PPAs and no committed green capex. Zero hits for 'solar', 'PPA', 'power purchase agreement', 'photovoltaic' or 'biomass' in the 2025 One Report. Five-year CAPEX plan (p.134) breaks committed spend into US$55m IT/digital/office/operational excellence, US$110m ethane feedstock security, US$388m allnex expansion - none green. Only MW-scale agreements are GC SELLING gas-fired cogeneration to EGAT (30MW firm / 60MW non-firm), which is the opposite of green procurement. Portfolio Transformation confirmed as a cost programme, not green capex.
